functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_create_sco_shadow_draft_v1(p_canonical_product_id uuid, p_brief_queue_id uuid, p_generation_run_id uuid, p_proposal_hash text, p_generation_model text, p_compiler_version text, p_product_truth_snapshot jsonb, p_manual_focus_snapshot jsonb, p_keyword_roles_snapshot jsonb, p_metrics_status_snapshot jsonb, p_agent_input_snapshot jsonb, p_agent_output_snapshot jsonb, p_validation_result_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(draft_id uuid, created_new boolean, draft_status text, review_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_existing public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1%rowtype;
  v_product public.feya_commerce_product_drafts%rowtype;
  v_draft public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1%rowtype;
  v_seo_title text;
  v_h1 text;
  v_meta text;
  v_intro text;
  v_bullets jsonb;
  v_faq jsonb;
  v_alts jsonb;
  v_links jsonb;
begin
  if p_generation_run_id is null then
    raise exception 'generation_run_id is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_proposal_hash,'')),'') is null then
    raise exception 'proposal_hash is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_generation_model,'')),'') is null then
    raise exception 'generation_model is required';
  end if;

  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_compiler_version,'')),'') is null then
    raise exception 'compiler_version is required';
  end if;

  if p_agent_output_snapshot is null
     or jsonb_typeof(p_agent_output_snapshot) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'agent_output_snapshot must be a JSON object';
  end if;

  select *
    into v_existing
  from public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
  where d.generation_run_id=p_generation_run_id
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return query
    select v_existing.id,false,v_existing.status,v_existing.review_status;
    return;
  end if;

  select *
    into v_product
  from public.feya_commerce_product_drafts p
  where p.canonical_product_id=p_canonical_product_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Product draft not found: %',p_canonical_product_id;
  end if;

  select *
    into v_existing
  from public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
  where d.canonical_product_id=p_canonical_product_id
    and d.archived_at is null
  order by d.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return query
    select v_existing.id,false,v_existing.status,v_existing.review_status;
    return;
  end if;

  select *
    into v_existing
  from public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
  where d.canonical_product_id=p_canonical_product_id
    and d.proposal_hash=p_proposal_hash
  order by d.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return query
    select v_existing.id,false,v_existing.status,v_existing.review_status;
    return;
  end if;

  v_seo_title := nullif(btrim(p_agent_output_snapshot ->> 'seo_title'),'');
  v_h1 := nullif(btrim(p_agent_output_snapshot ->> 'h1'),'');
  v_meta := nullif(btrim(p_agent_output_snapshot ->> 'meta_description'),'');
  v_intro := nullif(btrim(p_agent_output_snapshot ->> 'intro'),'');
  v_bullets := coalesce(p_agent_output_snapshot -> 'bullet_highlights','[]'::jsonb);
  v_faq := coalesce(p_agent_output_snapshot -> 'faq','[]'::jsonb);
  v_alts := coalesce(p_agent_output_snapshot -> 'image_alt_candidates','[]'::jsonb);
  v_links := coalesce(p_agent_output_snapshot -> 'internal_linking_hints','[]'::jsonb);

  if v_seo_title is null or v_h1 is null or v_meta is null or v_intro is null then
    raise exception 'SCO shadow proposal is missing a required core content field';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(v_bullets) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(v_faq) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(v_alts) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(v_links) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'SCO shadow proposal array fields have invalid JSON types';
  end if;

  insert into public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 (
    canonical_product_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_slug,
    pack_version,
    source_brief_version,
    output_contract_version,
    status,
    review_status,
    source_mode,
    source_decision_id,
    seo_title,
    h1,
    meta_description,
    intro,
    bullet_highlights,
    faq,
    image_alt_candidates,
    internal_linking_hints,
    product_truth_snapshot,
    manual_focus_snapshot,
    keyword_roles_snapshot,
    metrics_status_snapshot,
    qa_self_report,
    similarity_check_snapshot,
    agent_input_snapshot,
    agent_output_snapshot,
    validation_result_snapshot,
    human_review_notes,
    reviewer,
    reviewed_at,
    created_by,
    generation_run_id,
    proposal_hash,
    compiler_version,
    source_brief_queue_id
  )
  values (
    p_canonical_product_id,
    coalesce(
      p_product_truth_snapshot ->> 'matched_etsy_listing_id',
      v_product.matched_etsy_listing_id
    ),
    coalesce(
      p_product_truth_snapshot ->> 'product_slug',
      p_product_truth_snapshot ->> 'slug'
    ),
    'growth_os_sco_shadow_v1',
    'seo_content_brief_v1-shadow',
    'sco_content_proposal_v1',
    'draft_generated',
    'not_reviewed',
    'growth_os_sco_shadow',
    null,
    v_seo_title,
    v_h1,
    v_meta,
    v_intro,
    v_bullets,
    v_faq,
    v_alts,
    v_links,
    coalesce(p_product_truth_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_manual_focus_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_keyword_roles_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p_metrics_status_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'notes',jsonb_build_array(
        'Growth OS SCO shadow draft. Independent CQA and human review are required before publish.'
      ),
      'similarity_cannibalization','not_checked',
      'image_alt_truth','not_checked',
      'component_claim_truth','not_checked',
      'keyword_stuffing','not_checked',
      'validated_metrics','not_checked',
      'forbidden_mismatch','not_checked',
      'product_specificity','not_checked',
      'commercial_placement','not_checked',
      'cliche_phrase','not_checked',
      'long_dash','not_checked'
    ),
    null,
    coalesce(p_agent_input_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    p_agent_output_snapshot,
    coalesce(p_validation_result_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),
    null,
    null,
    null,
    'openai:' || p_generation_model,
    p_generation_run_id,
    p_proposal_hash,
    p_compiler_version,
    p_brief_queue_id
  )
  returning * into v_draft;

  insert into public.feya_commerce_seo_pack_draft_events_v1 (
    draft_id,
    canonical_product_id,
    event_type,
    from_status,
    to_status,
    actor,
    note,
    payload
  )
  values (
    v_draft.id,
    v_draft.canonical_product_id,
    'draft_created',
    null,
    v_draft.status,
    'openai:' || p_generation_model,
    'Growth OS SCO shadow draft created from deterministic Content Brief Compiler',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'generation_run_id',p_generation_run_id,
      'proposal_hash',p_proposal_hash,
      'compiler_version',p_compiler_version,
      'source_brief_queue_id',p_brief_queue_id,
      'source_mode','growth_os_sco_shadow'
    )
  );

  return query
  select v_draft.id,true,v_draft.status,v_draft.review_status;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_record_ai_invocation_v1(p_action_code text, p_domain_owner text, p_source_endpoint text, p_run_id text, p_dry_run boolean, p_item_count integer, p_model_requested text, p_model_resolved text, p_prompt_version text, p_response_id text, p_invocation_status text, p_http_status integer, p_input_tokens bigint, p_cached_input_tokens bigint, p_output_tokens bigint, p_reasoning_output_tokens bigint, p_total_tokens bigint, p_latency_ms integer, p_metadata_json jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(invocation_id uuid, created_new boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if nullif(btrim(p_action_code),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(p_domain_owner),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(p_source_endpoint),'') is null
     or nullif(btrim(p_model_requested),'') is null then
    raise exception 'AI invocation action/domain/endpoint/model are required';
  end if;

  if p_item_count is null or p_item_count < 0 then
    raise exception 'AI invocation item_count must be >= 0';
  end if;

  if p_invocation_status not in ('RESPONSE_RECEIVED','USAGE_UNAVAILABLE','HTTP_ERROR') then
    raise exception 'Invalid AI invocation status: %', p_invocation_status;
  end if;

  if p_response_id is not null then
    select a.invocation_id
      into v_id
    from public.feya_growth_ai_invocations_v1 a
    where a.response_id = p_response_id;

    if v_id is not null then
      return query select v_id, false;
      return;
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.feya_growth_ai_invocations_v1 (
    action_code,
    domain_owner,
    source_endpoint,
    run_id,
    dry_run,
    item_count,
    model_requested,
    model_resolved,
    prompt_version,
    response_id,
    invocation_status,
    http_status,
    input_tokens,
    cached_input_tokens,
    output_tokens,
    reasoning_output_tokens,
    total_tokens,
    latency_ms,
    metadata_json
  )
  values (
    btrim(p_action_code),
    btrim(p_domain_owner),
    btrim(p_source_endpoint),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_run_id,'')),''),
    coalesce(p_dry_run,true),
    p_item_count,
    btrim(p_model_requested),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_model_resolved,'')),''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_prompt_version,'')),''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_response_id,'')),''),
    p_invocation_status,
    p_http_status,
    p_input_tokens,
    p_cached_input_tokens,
    p_output_tokens,
    p_reasoning_output_tokens,
    p_total_tokens,
    p_latency_ms,
    coalesce(p_metadata_json,'{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict (response_id) do nothing
  returning feya_growth_ai_invocations_v1.invocation_id into v_id;

  if v_id is null and p_response_id is not null then
    select a.invocation_id
      into v_id
    from public.feya_growth_ai_invocations_v1 a
    where a.response_id = p_response_id;

    return query select v_id, false;
    return;
  end if;

  return query select v_id, true;
end;
$function$
